products.title: Oakley vs. Dolan Signed Print/ Post Card
products.body_html:
This is my humorous and satirical boxing poster that pits Charles Oakley, a beloved former Knicks player, against James Dolan, the owner of the Knicks and Madison Square Garden. The poster takes a playful jab at their infamous feud, portraying it as a long-anticipated fight. The vintage-style poster is eye-catching, with its bold yellow and red design, reminiscent of classic boxing promotion posters.

On the left, Charles Oakley is labeled as “Oak Tree”, with his stats highlighting his significance to Knicks fans. His “Games Played: 1,288” reflects his impressive career as a player, underscoring his dedication to the team.

On the right, James Dolan is labeled as “Money Tree”, a cheeky reference to his role as the wealthy owner of the Knicks. His stats humorously highlight his lack of experience in the sport, with “Games Played: 0”, poking fun at Dolan’s management role and his detachment from the on-court experience that Oakley embodies.
